themes.title: Far-right push for 'national priority' policies
themes.blurb: Right-wing and far-right parties across Europe continue to advocate for 'national priority' policies, which prioritize citizens over immigrants in access to social services, housing, and public aid. This theme is particularly strong in Spain, Italy, and Sweden, where such policies are being formalized in regional budgets and legislative proposals.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Proposes 'national priority' in Valencian budgets, restricting social aid and housing to Spanish citizens.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Supports 'national priority' policies in regional governance, particularly in housing and social services.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Advocates for prioritizing Swedish citizens in welfare and housing policies.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Pushes for stricter immigration controls and prioritization of Norwegian citizens in public services.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Promotes policies favoring French citizens in social welfare and housing access.

themes.title: Javier Milei’s declining approval amid internal strife

themes.title: Far-right gains in European local elections
themes.blurb: Right-wing and far-right parties have made significant gains in recent local elections across Europe, particularly in Italy, Spain, and France. These victories are seen as a bellwether for upcoming national elections and reflect growing public support for conservative and nationalist policies.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Gains influence in regional governments through coalitions with PP, particularly in Valencia and Aragón.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Bardella leads in presidential polls, signaling strong far-right momentum.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: Makes gains in local elections, particularly in Saxony-Anhalt.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Continues to gain ground in local elections, particularly in rural areas.
